resources.name: Trip Invite - GETs & POSTs
resources.description: Run top to bottom: sign in, create a trip to invite people to, then test the invite routes.

resources.name: 1. Sign in with Google
resources.description: Click the Auth tab > Fetch Tokens to log in with Google, then Send. Saves csrf_token, profile_id and profile_name.

resources.name: 2. POST create trip (setup)
resources.description: Generates a fresh trip_id each time you send.

resources.name: 3. POST send invite
resources.description: Owner only. Needs email or cellNumber. Saves invite_token from the response.

resources.name: 4. GET invites for trip
resources.description: Owner only. Returns every invite for the trip.

resources.name: 6. GET one invite by id
resources.description: Owner only. Returns one invite, without its token.

resources.name: 7. POST decline invite (public)
resources.description: No login needed. Send twice: 1st = 200 declined, 2nd = 409 already declined.

resources.name: 8. DELETE revoke invite
resources.description: Owner only. Run last - after this, 6 returns 404.
